title_en: Merge After Toll: Toll-plaza layout and downstream congestion
title_zh: 收费站后的汇流：收费站布局与下游拥堵
assessment_en: Latest semantic review covers the pre-layout TeX and selected numerical claims. A 17-page visual check exists for earlier PDF hash b4af…, not the current 13b6… PDF. Latest review abstains from an award estimate.
assessment_zh: 最新全文语义审阅审查终稿前一TeX版本与选定数值；当前PDF有17页视觉检查记录，但记录哈希是此前版b4af…，不绑定当前13b6… PDF。最新评议不提供奖档估计。
strength_en: Links payment compatibility, booth layout, merging and finite downstream storage, while retaining rejected routes and conditional conclusions.
strength_zh: 连接支付兼容、窗口布局、汇合和有限出口占用；保存被拒路线与条件结论。
limits_en: No field calibration of safety or land costs; current PDF lacks a page-review receipt bound to its exact hash.
limits_zh: 没有现场安全/土地成本标定；当前PDF缺同哈希逐页视觉回执。
reviewer_identity_zh: 作者外AI全文语义评议；另有独立AI版面审查，均非真人。
reviewer_identity_en: Author-external AI semantic review plus a separate AI layout review; no human reviewer.
identity_zh: 自主完成稿 / autonomous completed manuscript
additional_note_zh: 历史9页首稿保留为单独版本，不随本条终稿链接打包。
additional_note_en: A separate 9-page historical first draft is retained but not bundled with this final-paper link.
review_scope_en: Latest semantic review covers pre-layout TeX and selected claims; it abstains from an award estimate. Existing visual check is for an earlier PDF hash, not this one.
review_scope_zh: 最新语义评阅覆盖排版前 TeX 与选定主张，不给奖档判断；已有视觉检查针对更早 PDF 哈希，不绑定当前版。
